correctness.rationale: Verified every essential inference by hand and by re-running stdlib scripts. Grad F=(-3X^2-2XZ,2YZ,Y^2-X^2) over F7: case Y!=0 forces Z=0 then X=0 then contradiction, so Y=0 and X=0, hence Sing(S)=V(X,Y) exactly; brute force over A^3(F7) reproduces exactly 7 singular points all with X=Y=0. Blow-up charts: X-chart G_X=U^2V-V-1 with grad (2UV,U^2-1) never zero on G_X=0 since G_X|_{U^2=1}=-1 (smooth); Y-chart G_Y=C(1-A^2)-A^3 with grad (-2AC-3A^2,1-A^2) never zero on G_Y=0 since G_Y|_{A^2=1}=-A^3!=0 (smooth); Z-chart G_Z=B^2-A^3-A^2 with grad (-3A^2-2A,2B,0) vanishing exactly along line A=B=0 with free C, and A=4 solns have no F7-point since 3 is non-square, so Bl_0(S) singular along proper transform of z-axis. E identified as nodal cubic in Z-chart (C=0) and X-chart (X=0). Split node Y^2-X^2=(Y-X)(Y+X) with normalization t->(t^2-1,t(t^2-1),1) verified on curve and fiber {1,6} confirmed by script. KH_{-1}(S)=0 via cone A1-homotopy H(p,t)=t*p and KH A1-invariance plus regularity of F7 is standard and correctly applied. H^1(C,O(m)) vanishing for m>=1 via O(3m) pullback with two-point evaluation rank 2 (checked m=1..4) is correct; m=0 gives F7. Report honestly separates proved/hand, computed, and open K_{-1}(S). No computation error found.
